about: Recursion: a fired entry wakes others through its text; preventRecursion and excludeRecursion; three levels deep.

messages.text: *Mira looks up from the logbook.* You came through that weather? Sit down and dry off.
I shake the rain off and set my satchel down. The ferry nearly turned back.
*She pours tea without asking.* It should have. Nobody crosses on a night like this.
I lift the lantern and look toward the harbor.
